cohort.sampling_rule: for every fixed Japanese region cell x plant/animal x within-frame record-count quartile, sample exactly two previously unused species; no substitution across cells/strata and no replacement after declaration

outer_validation.candidate_generation: build_automatic_discover_bundle(..., candidate_generation_only=True) using training occurrences only
outer_validation.failure_rule: declared pair/fold failures remain in intention-to-evaluate denominator as zero for operational methods; taxa are never replaced after cohort freeze

grts.frame: identical finite ACSP candidate rows after training-only generation and known-location exclusion
grts.recovery_estimand: mean Top-5 held-out recovery over the predeclared GRTS draws per fold; 50 draws for the primary proportional-local+10km comparator and 10 draws for each secondary GRTS variant
grts.mindis_failure_handling: retain official grts output and warning/audit; do not tune mindis or rerun with a favorable threshold

fitted_sdm.implementation: unchanged production-aligned fitted-SDM Top-5 contract from validation/sdm_topk_protocol.json
fitted_sdm.interpretation: decision-level secondary contrast, not universal model comparison

superiority_gate.local_evidence_top_k: mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
superiority_gate.official_grts_proportional_local_mindis1: mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
superiority_gate.frozen_acsp_v1: pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05

inference.claim_rule: ACSP v2 is not promoted as superior unless every ordered gate passes on the complete untouched cohort; negative/equivalent results are retained and no retuning is permitted on this cohort

power_basis.reason_for_192_pairs: 192 balances 12 fixed region cells x 2 taxon groups x 4 record-count strata x 2 taxa and provides >80% approximate paired-normal power for a 0.015 gain at the observed development SD

biosurvey_end_to_end.reason: biosurvey natively selects from a region and environmental raster master matrix, not an arbitrary ACSP finite candidate frame
biosurvey_end_to_end.claim_boundary: same-pool confirmation can support superiority over GRTS/local/v1 under the ACSP candidate universe; a broader tool-level superiority claim additionally requires a predeclared end-to-end biosurvey comparison

prospective_field_gate.required_for: claims about access, detection probability, discoveries per field day, route efficiency, or replacement-site utility

leakage_guardrail: held-out coordinates and outcomes are attached only after every operational selection for that fold is frozen; no method may use held-out recovery as an inference-time feature
